## Function

```{r}
getFrequencySpecificNew <- function(allele, continent)
{
  #cat(row,"\n")
  #dx <- data.in[row,]
  
  test <- XML::readHTMLTable(sprintf("http://www.allelefrequencies.net/hla6006a_scr.asp?hla_locus=&hla_locus_type=Classical&hla_allele1=%s&hla_allele2=%s&hla_selection=&hla_pop_selection=&hla_population=&hla_country=&hla_dataset=&hla_region=%s&hla_ethnic=&hla_study=&hla_sample_size=&hla_sample_size_pattern=equal&hla_sample_year=&hla_sample_year_pattern=equal&hla_level=&hla_level_pattern=equal&hla_show=&hla_order=order_1&standard=a", allele, allele, continent))
  
  
  
  testx <- test[[3]]
  if(is.null(testx)) return()
  
  #testx <- testx[testx$`Sample Size` >= 1000,]
  
  testx$Region <- continent
  
  testx$AlleleFrequency <- as.numeric(testx$`Allele Frequency`)
  #nms <- by(testx$AlleleFrequency, testx$Region, mean) %>% sort() %>% as.list() %>% names()
  #testx$Region <- factor(testx$Region, levels=nms)
  testx
  
}
```

## Read DB

```{r}
db <- rio::import("HLA_NEO_TAA.xlsx")
```

## Get continents

```{r}
load("/Users/rcslieker/Documents/LCCO/001_Projects/045_HLA_Disparity/freqs.all.complete.RData")
regions <- unique(freqs.all.complete$Region)
regions <- strsplit(regions, split = " \\(") %>% do.call(what=c)
regions <- regions[-grep(")",regions)]

```

## Get study names

```{r, eval=F}
region.data <- lapply(regions, function(rx){
  out.A <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "A*", continent = rx)
}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)

region.data <- unique(region.data[,c("Population","Region")])
rio::export(region.data, file="./region.data.xlsx")
```


## Get all alleles


### A

```{r,eval=F}
out.A <- lapply(regions, function(rx){
  cat(rx,"\n")
  out <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "A*", continent = rx)
}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)
save(out.A, file="Alleles_A.RData")
```


### B

```{r,eval=F}
out.B <- lapply(regions, function(rx){
  cat(rx,"\n")
  out1 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*0", continent = rx)
  out2 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*1", continent = rx)
  out3 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*2", continent = rx)
  out4 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*3", continent = rx)
  out5 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*4", continent = rx)
  out6 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "B*5", continent = rx)
  
  out <- rbind(out1, out2, out3, out4, out5, out6)
  out
}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)
save(out.B, file="Alleles_B.RData")
```

### C

```{r,eval=F}
out.C <- region.data <- lapply(regions, function(rx){
  cat(rx,"\n")
  out <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = "C*", continent = rx)
}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)
save(out.C, file="Alleles_C.RData")
```

## Class II

```{r}
tx <- unique(db$Alelele)
tx <- tx[-grep("HLA-A", tx)]
tx <- tx[-grep("HLA-B", tx)]
tx <- tx[-grep("HLA-C", tx)]
tx <- strsplit(tx,"\\/") %>% do.call(what=c) %>% gsub(pattern = "\\+", replacement = "") %>% unique()
tx
tx <- tx[-grep("Unrestricted", tx)]
tx <- gsub("HLA-","",tx)

```

DRA, DRB, DPA, DPB, DQA, DQB


```{r,eval=F}
out <- lapply(tx, function(i){
    cat(i,"\n")
    out1 <- getFrequencySpecificNew(allele = i, continent = "")
    save(out1, file=sprintf("./Class2/Results_ClassII_%s.RData", i))

}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)
```

```{r,eval=F}
out.class2 <- lapply(list.files("./Class2", full.names = TRUE), function(i){
  load(i)
  out1
}) %>% do.call(what=rbind)

save(out.class2, file="Alleles_classII.RData")
```

## Combine data

```{r}
Allele.AllStudies <- rbind(out.A, out.B, out.C, out.class2)
dim(Allele.AllStudies)

Allele.AllStudies1 <- Allele.AllStudies[Allele.AllStudies$Region != "",]

Allele.AllStudies2 <- Allele.AllStudies[Allele.AllStudies$Region == "",]
Allele.AllStudies2$Region <- Allele.AllStudies1$Region[match(Allele.AllStudies2$Population, Allele.AllStudies1$Population)]
Allele.AllStudies2a <- Allele.AllStudies2[is.na(Allele.AllStudies2$Region),]
Allele.AllStudies2b <- Allele.AllStudies2[!is.na(Allele.AllStudies2$Region),]
rio::export(unique(Allele.AllStudies2a[,c("Population","Region")]), file="Additional_Regions.xlsx")
mods <- rio::import("Additional_Regions_mod.xlsx")

Allele.AllStudies2a$Region <- mods[match(Allele.AllStudies2a$Population, mods$Population),2]

Allele.AllStudies <- rbind(Allele.AllStudies1, Allele.AllStudies2a, Allele.AllStudies2b)
dim(Allele.AllStudies)
#dim(unique(Allele.AllStudies))
save(Allele.AllStudies, file="Allele.AllStudies.RData")


table(Allele.AllStudies$Region)
```
